messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — billing.usage.ingest.pipeline LAG detected (severity: P1). 500k msg lag on consumer group `usage-ingest-main`. Possible customer invoice impact. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/usage-pipeline; runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/ingest-runbook

pagerduty-bot: PD incident opened: PD123456 — notified on-call (ryan). See incident timeline in PagerDuty.

ryan: acking in PD, looking. I’m oncall now, pulling logs. Can someone confirm customer-facing invoices are blocked or just late?

jen: I’m seeing token-counts low for a subset of customers. Looks like downstream writebacks to the ledger are delayed. Not full invoice stops yet but risk of invoice generation failure if lag stays.

alex: joining. I can check the consumer group offsets. Running: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group usage-ingest-main`

alex: output snippet:
```
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage-raw       0          12457890        12999990        542100
usage-raw       1          12456000        12998000        542000
```

maria: that’s bad. Any recent deploys? I see a minor schema update merged an hour ago in `producer-service` but it was behind a feature flag. Could be producers choking and requeuing.

lucas: checking producer logs for schema errors. grep for Avro/deserialize failures.

lucas: found repeated `AvroTypeException` on topic usage-raw: `org.apache.avro.AvroTypeException: Found java.lang.String, expecting int` — looks like a field type mismatch from a producer. Producers may be sending incorrect type causing consumer to crash/slow when deserializing.

ryan: ok that explains requeues. Devs, can we patch consumers to skip bad messages temporarily so pipeline can catch up? If not, we scale consumers to reduce lag while we triage.

jen: there’s a quick mitigation in runbook: set `SKIP_BAD_MESSAGES=true` in `usage-ingest` deployment env and restart pods. That will drop offending messages (we’ll capture to quarantine topic). Recommend doing that now + scale to 6 replicas.

alex: executing rollout now: `kubectl set env deploy/usage-ingest SKIP_BAD_MESSAGES=true && kubectl scale deploy usage-ingest --replicas=6`

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started for `usage-ingest` by alex — tracking in #eng-releases.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 acknowledged by ryan (on-call).

maria: also opening a quarantine topic `usage-raw-quarantine` and a small consumer to persist bad records for forensics. Lucas can you confirm we capture the raw events?

lucas: quarantine consumer deployed to write to S3 + retention 90d. logs show we are capturing ~700 error messages/minute initially.

jen: monitoring offsets. If lag falls below 100k we can start invoice backfills.

alex: lag after scaling & skip flag: `~120k` and trending down slowly. CPU on pods spiked but healthy.

ryan: good. Next: set temporary invoice-hold for sensitive customers to avoid partial invoices. I’ll coordinate with CS to message affected accounts. Maria, can you prepare the affected-customer list?

maria: generating list now — pulling from ledger writes with `status!=confirmed` and last-write > 30m. Will post CSV to the incident ticket.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 — escalation policy will notify next rotation in 15m if not resolved.

lucas: for long term fix we need to roll back the producer schema change or enforce contract at the producer CI. I’ll open a PR to add stricter validation.

jen: agreed. Action items: 1) Hold invoices for flagged customers (ryan) 2) CS comms (maria) 3) Quarantine bad messages (lucas) 4) Rollout skip+scale (alex) 5) Root cause PR for schema validation (lucas) 6) Postmortem if invoices actually block (jen).

ryan: I’ll stay on this. If lag < 20k and ledger confirms writes resume, we can remove hold and close PD. Current ETA 40–60m to stabilize.

alex: FYI I pushed a small monitor that alerts when `quarantine-rate > 100/min` so we can spot repeat bad producers.

incident-bot: Update: PD123456 status: Investigating -> Mitigated. Automatic note: mitigation actions applied (skip bad messages + scale).

maria: uploaded affected_customers.csv to the incident ticket, started draft CS message.

jen: handing off to next oncall (ryan to jen rotation) at timestamp 2499990300 — please ack and monitor until fully closed.

ryan: acked handoff, will follow through. Adding estimated postmortem owner: lucas.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 — resolved by ryan. Incident closed in PagerDuty.

alex: leaving a quick post-incident note in #postmortems with command snippets and the quarantine S3 path: s3://redwood-incident/PD123456/quarantine/

lucas: PR to enforce Avro validation opened: https://github.com/redwood/producers/pull/432 — includes schema checks + unit tests.

jen: good work team. We’ll triage for a formal postmortem if invoices were delayed > 2 hours or > 10 customers impacted. For now, incident state = mitigated, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
